NOTICE OF CANCELLATION – TDVA BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING
Please be advised that the Tahoe Douglas Visitors Authority (TDVA) Board of Directors meeting scheduled for Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. has been canceled due to the confirmed inability to establish a quorum. The meeting will be rescheduled, and notice of the new meeting date and time will be provided in accordance with applicable public meeting requirements.
